Performance Model for Voice Translation Modes

The voice recognition rounds the cost of each request to the nearest multiple of 15 seconds, the average total cost (both translator and voice recognition), without taking into account the rounding, is 2.5 dollars per hour, also for WalkieTalkie must add the language detection costs to the translation, to learn more read the tutorial

To find out how to get the key file read the tutorial
Your name will be displayed by all nearby devices, while your profile picture will only be shown on devices with which you have already had conversations
Now RTranslator will download the neural network models necessary for translation and speech recognition, once finished you can start using the app (even offline).

The Conversation mode is the main feature of RTranslator, it allows you to translate a conversation between several people in real time, for a better experience it is recommended to connect bluetooth headphones to the phone, furthermore the application will continue to work also in background and with the phone on standby (however, some phones may have performance issues when the app runs in the background)

WalkieTalkie mode is the secondary functionality of RTranslator, it does not allow real-time translation but is designed to work with just one phone, it automatically detects and translates a speech in a language into another language, and the application will continue to work in background and with the phone on standby

RTranslator uses OpenAi\'s Whisper for speech recognition and Meta\'s NLLB for translations, these models require quite a bit of power and at least 6GB of RAM to run, so make sure you\'re using a modern smartphone to avoid slowdowns or crashes. For more info on RTranslator visit the GitHub project of the app here
To speak, RTranslator uses the system\'s default TTS engine, the recommended TTS is the Google TTS, but you can choose the one you prefer, to select it, click on the button below
Notifications will be used only to improve background operations like the downloads or other background tasks. This app will never send notifications.
To use Conversation mode, allow RTranslator to use Bluetooth.
To use WalkieTalkie mode, allow RTranslator to access your microphone.

To translate your voice in Conversation mode, allow RTranslator to access your microphone. If you don\'t grant this permission, the mode will still work, but you will only be able to send text messages or receive and play translations.
Mono language lightweight models created by Mozilla; they have a similar quality to 2024\'s Google Translate. \n\nModel: Mozilla 16-60M fp32
Middleweight model created by Tencent; it has the best quality, better than Google Translate, comparable to Deepseek v3 and Gemini 3.0. \n\nModel: HY-MT-1.5 1.8B int8
Heavy model created by Google; it has a quality in-between the Mozilla and HY-MT models but supports 400 languages. \n\nModel: Madlad 3B int4
